* [[Michiko]] ([[Kaineng Center]])

== Hero Usage ==
* If no spirits are within earshot, Heroes will prefer using other healing skills, but will use this spell if none are available. Unlike some other healing skills (such as [[Word of Healing]]), the AI will not use Spirit Light to heal non-[[party]] ally [[Non-player character|NPCs]].

== Notes ==
* Sacrifice occurs before healing, so this can kill the caster if used as a [[self heal]] without spirits around.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
